caption: The drawing features a symmetrical design on a textured beige background. At the top, there is a stylized cross outlined in red with blue and yellow interior details, emitting yellow rays on either side. Beneath the cross, there is a bow-like shape with four blue and red loops connected at a circular center that features yellow and blue details. To the left and right of the bow, there are two symmetrical abstract shapes colored in gold with small red accents at the tips, resembling wings or leaves. Below this arrangement, a large circular mandala occupies the lower half of the drawing, filled with intricate geometric patterns in red, blue, and gold. The mandala has a central circle surrounded by petal-like and triangular shapes in alternating colors, bordered by two concentric circles. The composition uses a color palette of red, blue, gold, and yellow, all set against the aged, parchment-like background.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
